# Krish Khati | AI Developer

> Krish Khati - AI Developer building AI-powered apps, chatbots and web projects: gym website design, memory match game, AI language translator and calculator app UI. Currently looking for an entry-level role or internship.

The site is a single-page app with prerendered HTML for every public page. Content may be summarized and cited with a link back to the source page.
